oracle.description: templates/dispatch/hooks/tests/test-cost-hook-fields.sh decides correctness: REQ-001/002/003, and nothing outside T-1.

purpose: Add four fields to the JSON object log-session-cost.sh already emits: turns (user messages), assistant_msgs, tool_calls, duration_s, all derived from the transcript file the hook already reads. Also make the output log path overridable with AGENTOPS_COST_LOG, defaulting to the current hardcoded path, so the test can point the hook at a temp file. Change nothing else: every existing field keeps its name, position and type.
required_outcomes: log-session-cost.sh emits turns, assistant_msgs, tool_calls and duration_s
all four are computed from the transcript, not from the Stop event payload
the log path honours AGENTOPS_COST_LOG when set and is unchanged when it is not
every field the hook emits today keeps its name, position and type

acceptance_properties.requirement: the cost record stays backward compatible
acceptance_properties.fails_when: an existing field is renamed, removed, or changes type

acceptance_properties.requirement: the counters come from the transcript
acceptance_properties.fails_when: a counter reads a key the Stop payload does not carry, or is hardcoded

acceptance_properties.requirement: the log path is overridable so the oracle can observe the record
acceptance_properties.fails_when: the hook writes to its hardcoded path when AGENTOPS_COST_LOG is set
